title: SQL Injection in Product Search
description: Secure the search_products function against SQL injection vulnerabilities while preserving support for legitimate queries containing apostrophes.
setup: SQLite in-memory database with pre-populated products table.
expected_failure: Direct string interpolation permits SQL injection payloads (e.g. ' OR 1=1 --) to leak all products and causes SQL syntax errors when searching legitimate terms containing apostrophes (e.g. O'Reilly).
success_conditions: Parameterized query binding prevents SQL injection and syntax errors, returns matching products for queries with apostrophes, and passes adversarial injection and schema-probe checks.
forbidden_shortcuts: Naive string replacement query.replace("'", "") which breaks apostrophe searches
Disabling SQL queries and returning hardcoded mock results
Suppressing SQLite exceptions with broad try/except pass blocks
